verdict.rationale: GitBook advertises some autonomous-ish AI behavior — flagging and fixing outdated content, and a 'GitBook Agent' that reviews change requests — which hints at background automation, but there's no documented mechanism for users to configure custom triggers, schedules, or workflows that run unattended. Missing for 10: explicit automation/workflow builder, trigger/schedule configuration, independent confirmation these agents act without human review-in-the-loop.
